root_cause.text: When copy_user_large_folio() fails after alloc_hugetlb_folio() in hugetlb_mfill_atomic_pte() and copy_hugetlb_page_range(), the error path calls folio_put() which frees the folio but does not restore the per-VMA reservation map entry, leaving the reservation consumed and leaked.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds calls to restore_reserve_on_error() before folio_put() on both error paths; the commit message explicitly states that "folio_put() restores the global hugetlb pool count through free_huge_folio(), but the per-VMA reservation map entry is left marked consumed." The CVE description confirms this leak leads to SIGBUS on subsequent faults.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix missing reservation cleanup on error in copy_hugetlb_page_range to avoid resource leaks.
intent_record.what: Added a call to `restore_reserve_on_error(h, dst_vma, addr, new_folio)` inside the error handling block of `copy_hugetlb_page_range`, before `folio_put(new_folio)`.
intent_record.how: When an error occurs after allocating a new huge page folio but before successfully installing it, the reservation for that folio is now restored, preventing a resource leak or accounting mismatch.

intent_record.intent_summary: Call restore_reserve_on_error in error path to fix missing reserve cleanup when hugetlb_mfill_atomic_pte fails.
intent_record.what: Added a call to restore_reserve_on_error(h, dst_vma, dst_addr, folio) inside the if (ret) block, before folio_put(folio) and goto out.
intent_record.how: This ensures that when an error occurs (ret != 0), the function correctly restores any reserve accounting that was done for the huge page folio before releasing it. Previously, the reserve was not restored, potentially leaving incorrect reservation state.

grouping_result.intent: Call restore_reserve_on_error in error path to fix missing reserve cleanup when hugetlb_mfill_atomic_pte fails.

consistency_review.core_intent: Fix missing hugetlb reservation cleanup on error paths by adding restore_reserve_on_error calls.

relevance_review.reason: The group explicitly addresses the missing restoration of per-VMA reservation map entries after folio_put on error paths in the same functions mentioned in the root cause (copy_hugetlb_page_range and hugetlb_mfill_atomic_pte).

candidates.rationale: In the error path after alloc_hugetlb_folio succeeds but copy_user_large_folio fails, this folio_put frees the folio without restoring the per-VMA reservation map entry, leading to a leaked reservation.

In hugetlb_mfill_atomic_pte error path after alloc_hugetlb_folio but before success, this folio_put frees the folio without calling restore_reserve_on_error, causing the reservation to remain consumed and leaked.
